artworks.title: Le calvaire (1ère planche) (Calvary) (first plate)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing several figures, including two men in the foreground and three women towards the center-left. The men have facial hair and short hair styles, with their arms folded. The women are wearing long, flowing garments and are huddled together. A ladder is visible in the background to the right. The figures have no objects in their hands or visible jewelry. The background is sparsely sketched, suggesting an empty space around the figures.

artworks.title: Le calvaire (2e planche) (Calvary) (second plate)
artworks.medium: etching with graphite and lithographic crayon additions on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures gathered around a ladder. Two groups of figures are on either side of a ladder extending upwards. On the left, three figures stand close together, draped in long garments. To the right of the ladder, a line of four figures are depicted standing in a slightly bowed posture. In the background, undefined lines and shading create a sense of an abstract sky or atmosphere.

artworks.title: Le calvaire (2e planche) (Calvary) (second plate)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures with a ladder in the background. The drawing shows several figures grouped on the right in loose garments. They have downturned heads. On the left, another group of figures is engaged with each other. A tall ladder leans diagonally to the right. The sketch features delicate, fluid lines giving an unfinished quality. The composition has empty space dominating the upper part of the canvas.

artworks.title: La route d'Emmaüs (1ère planche) (The Road to Emmaus) (first plate)
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring three figures in a dramatic scene. The central figure is walking forward in a robe, barefoot, and gesturing with open arms. Two other figures are adjacent, appearing to cling to each other for support. The background contains swirling lines suggesting motion or turbulence. The drawing emphasizes emotional intensity with heavy crosshatching and strong linework, evoking tension and drama. The style is reminiscent of expressionist techniques.

artworks.title: Femme mettant son bas (Woman Putting On Her Stockings)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person depicted from head to foot, seated on the edge of a bed. The figure is leaning forward with their elbows resting on their knees, and their head is slightly bowed downwards. Their hair is dark, voluminous, and appears to be tousled or unkempt, obscuring part of their face. The individual is portrayed in minimal clothing, with the main visible fabric being draped around them. The room features a bed covered with a textured blanket and two artworks on the walls, one showing abstract shapes and another with sketch-like outlines. The overall environment has a muted and subdued tone.

artworks.title: En cabinet particulier (1ère planche) (In a Private Room) (first plate)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper

artworks.title: En cabinet particulier (1ère planche) (In a Private Room) (first plate)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper

artworks.title: Sur le lit (On the Bed)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with a framed picture on the wall and a form reclining on the floor. The drawing depicts a room with vertical and horizontal lines suggesting wooden paneling on the walls. To the left, there is a framed picture hanging, presenting an indistinct figure, possibly a portrait, sketched with similar line work. In the foreground, a reclining form on the floor draws focus with its curves and texture. The use of cross-hatching adds depth and shadows, enhancing the textural quality of the walls and the figure, imparting a feeling of quiet solitude within an otherwise empty space.

artworks.title: Sur le lit (On the Bed)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying on a textured surface. The individual is positioned on their side, with one arm extended upward and the other resting beneath their head. The face is partially visible, displaying a profile with closed eyes and delicate features. The person's long, wavy hair cascades around their shoulder and the ground. They are unclothed, and there are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is a gradient of dark, cross-hatched lines creating an abstract, enclosed space, with softer, lighter shades surrounding the figure, emphasizing their presence against the darker backdrop.

artworks.title: Croquis de femme nue, la tête contre l'oreiller (1ère plance) (Sketch of a Nude Woman, Her Head Against a Pillow) (1st plate)
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's body with their back turned to the viewer, mostly visible from the head to the upper thighs. The person is positioned lying down, leaning on their stomach with the head raised to the right, and one arm is extended along the surface they are lying on. The facial features are not detailed, and the hair is styled in a loose bun or updo. The person is not clothed, and the minimalist style of the sketch does not present any additional clothing or objects around them. The sketch is against a plain backdrop with no distinct background elements.

artworks.title: A la table de jeu (1ère planche) (At the Gambling Table) (first plate)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image features an etching showing multiple figures in a lively scene. The composition includes several individuals gathered around a table. Most figures are seated or leaning, with two women wearing elaborate hats. The figures have distinct facial features, expressions, and detailed hairstyles. The clothing varies, with most wearing coats or jackets. Some individuals seem to be in conversation or resting their hands on the table. The background includes sketch-like outlines of more figures, suggesting a crowded, bustling indoor environment.

artworks.title: A la table de jeu (1ère planche) (At the Gambling Table) (first plate)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The sketch shows various people in different upper body positions. One man is in the foreground leaning forward, possibly resting his head on his hand. He has a mustache and short, combed-back hair. Next to him is another man with a mustache and thinning hair, slightly turned. The other people in the background appear casual or introspective. Two women are shown, one smiling slightly with voluminous hair possibly decorated with flowers, while the other has similar hair but her face is partly obscured. Another man wears a hat and coat, with less distinct facial features due to sketchy shading. The people are depicted in suits or formal attire typical of the early 20th century. The background features quick, cross-hatched lines creating a busy texture with no specific setting or objects. No jewelry or objects are shown in the sketch.

artworks.title: A la table de jeu (2e planche) (At the Gambling Table) (second plate)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a casino scene with individuals gathered around a gaming table. The drawing portrays a lively yet intimate setting, with several figures closely grouped around a table, indicating a scene of gambling or other casino activities. The figures are rendered in delicate pencil strokes, capturing their concentrated and engaged postures. The individuals wear classic attire, including suits and a large hat. The detailed line work emphasizes the facial features and expressions of focus, as well as the hands engaged in the game.

artworks.title: La madone et les enfants (The Madonna and the Children)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The sketch depicts four figures, appearing to be a group of people. One seated figure on the right is shown in profile, facing left and holding the arm of a child. The other three figures, likely children, are standing close together on the left. The middle child faces forward with a head turned slightly to the right, while the other two children have similar hairstyles. Each figure is wearing loose-fitting garments. The background is plain, without any detailed setting. The sketch lines are soft and flowing, creating a sense of gentle interaction among the group.

artworks.title: Paysage des environs de Versailles (Landscape in the Neighborhood of Versailles)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from a slightly elevated point of view. There is a lone tree slightly off-center to the right. The horizon line is minimal, with distant structures resembling farmhouses or cottages. A human figure and small animals walk along a path. The image is rendered in a monochrome palette of tan and soft brown, with sketch-like qualities. Brushstrokes and lines are executed in a free and spontaneous style.

artworks.title: La route de Rocquencourt (The Road to Rocquencourt)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with an elevated viewpoint, looking down a slight slope toward a house on the right partially hidden by foliage. The horizon is low in the image, faintly visible in the distance. The brushstrokes are loose and expressive, creating texture in the foliage and grass. The color palette is primarily sepia tones. There are bushes on the left and a figure seated near a path. The sky occupies the upper half of the image.

artworks.title: Avocat compulsant un dossier (Lawyer Going through a Brief)
artworks.medium: etching in blue on laid Van Gelder paper

artworks.title: Avocat compulsant un dossier (Lawyer Going through a Brief)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brown on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals, each showing three-quarters of their bodies. The person on the right is bending forward, looking down with their hands resting on a surface. They wear a dark coat and a hat obscuring their facial features. The middle person has their head covered with a slightly visible face. The person on the left, likely a child, is leaning over the ledge with their head slightly tilted downwards and short hair. None of the individuals hold any objects. The background is mostly dark with cross-hatched shading for depth, contrasting with the lighter figures. The drawing is monochromatic with dark tones emphasizing the characters' focus.

artworks.title: Un caboulet à montmartre (A Dive at Montmartre)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals. Two people are seated at a table in the foreground with their upper bodies visible. They wear hats and have curly hair. Another person stands to the left, only partially visible in a coat with pronounced collars. The fourth figure stands in the background with hair pulled back, dressed simply. The setting is suggested by vertical lines, and there is a small cup or bowl on the table. The image has a sketch-like quality with freeform line work.

artworks.title: Le Christ dépouillé de ses vêtements (Christ Stripped of His Clothes)
artworks.medium: drypoint in brown on wove Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures. One figure is bending slightly, and the other figure is standing close by. The drawing uses lines and cross-hatching to depict the forms and shadows of the figures. The surrounding area includes faintly drawn additional figures and a long rectangular shape on the ground. The lines in the drawing convey movement and create a sense of drama and tension.

artworks.title: Le Christ dépouillé de ses vêtements (Christ Stripped of His Clothes)
artworks.medium: drypoint and etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures. The central figure appears to be collapsed or burdened, surrounded by other engaging figures. On the left, a kneeling figure seems to be in a posture of offering. The background shows other figures observing the scene. The drawing uses dynamic lines, shadow, and hatching for intensity.

artworks.title: Le Christ aux outrages (The Mocking of Christ)
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of three individuals, with their upper bodies visible. The person on the right is seated and faces slightly to the left, wearing a crown of thorns. This figure has distinct features, a somber expression, full beard, and long hair. The person in the middle has their head turned towards the central figure, with a mustache and hair covered by a turban or thick scarf. The third figure, positioned lower and closer to the left, is smaller in scale with less distinct facial features. The background is minimally detailed, suggesting a simple interior with a hint of a window or door frame in the top right corner.

artworks.title: Après l'apparition (2e planche) (After the Vision) (second plate)
artworks.medium: drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a dining table with various items on it. The table is covered with a cloth and has bread, a bowl, and cups or mugs placed on it. Two figures are interacting with the items on the table, suggesting intimacy or companionship. The drawing technique uses crosshatched lines to outline shapes and shades. The background consists of abstract lines that provide texture and depth to the space. The illustration focuses on the interplay of light and shadow, conveying the mood of a moment centered around companionship at the table.

artworks.title: Après l'apparition (2e planche) (After the Vision) (second plate)
artworks.medium: drypoint in brown on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a table setting with objects and figures around it. The drawing illustrates a table covered with a cloth, featuring plates, bread, and a bottle. A wooden chair is placed on the left side, while two figures are seated closely together on the right. Their forms are depicted with loose lines indicating a sense of intimacy. The surroundings and details are suggested with minimal line work, creating a gentle atmosphere. Movement and texture are conveyed through the use of line, directing the viewer's focus to the center of the drawing.
